name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. This keeps the ring visible against any background while ensuring it doesn’t obscure content or blend into light themes. The trade-off is slightly less crisp focus visibility on high-contrast dark backgrounds, but it’s rare and the ring remains usable. This balances clarity for keyboard users with visual harmony across themes.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds where the 70% white inset blends the ring into the dark, making focus invisible. Use a 3px ring with a 1px #fff inset at 80% opacity instead—it’s sharper, meets contrast on both light and dark, and avoids blending. Test it in both themes with Playwright MCP’s contrast checks to settle it.
